facts.text: Nothing ever happens here. Please stop investigating and have some tea.
facts.why: Danny never says this. The quote pages I opened give him no such line. In the film Sandford is sold to Angel as quiet, but this wording is invented.
facts.fix: Sandford is the safest village in England. Have a cuppa, Nick.

facts.text: Serve the drinks when Angel orders a cranberry juice at the pub.

facts.text: Angel's cranberry lime cooler, no ice
facts.why: Angel does drink cranberry juice, but nothing shows lime or the no ice detail, so the name claims more than the film does.
facts.fix: Angel's cranberry, ginger and lime cooler

facts.text: Danny's order. Angel sticks to cranberry juice.
facts.why: In the pub scene Angel is offered another cranberry juice, and Danny later jokes about getting him something that isn't one.

vibe.verdict: A good pub menu in the right place with a cheeky tone, but a lot of the film's best jokes are left out.
